info.name: Kinlore API
info.description: Complete API collection for Kinlore - Multi-kid photo memory app with offline-first sync

request.description: Returns current authenticated user info including storage usage. storage_bytes_used is the sum of all uploaded file sizes, storage_bytes_available is the actual free disk space.

Get a single moment by ID. Returns file paths (not signed URLs) for use with the file proxy endpoints.

Response includes:
- `is_liked`: boolean, true if current user liked the moment
- `likes_count`: integer, total number of likes
- `comments_count`: integer, total number of comments
Stream thumbnail image through authenticated proxy. Checks for existence in SeaweedFS. Always returns Content-Type: image/jpeg as thumbnails are converted to JPEG.
Stream medium-sized image through authenticated proxy. Checks for existence in SeaweedFS. Always returns Content-Type: image/jpeg as medium files are converted to JPEG.
Stream original full-resolution image through authenticated proxy. Returns binary image data with proper Content-Type headers.
Diagnostic endpoint to check if all image files (original, medium, thumbnail) exist in SeaweedFS and their sizes. Use this to verify files are being saved correctly.

formdata.description: Select a video file (mp4, mov, avi, mkv, webm)

request.description: Upload a video for processing. Returns video ID and initiates background HLS transcoding.

query.description: Filter by status: uploading, processing, completed, failed

request.description: Poll for video processing status. Returns: uploading, processing, completed, or failed.
Stream HLS playlist through authenticated proxy. Use this URL in video players.
Returns all milestones grouped by stage (infancy, toddler, etc.)
Returns all milestones as a flat list.
Get milestones for a specific stage. Available stages: infancy_0_12m, toddler_1_3y, early_childhood_3_6y, middle_childhood_6_12y, adolescence_12_18y, young_adulthood_18_25y, partnership_marriage
Get a specific milestone by its string ID (e.g., first_smile, first_steps)
